_about: Chapter 6 (Travel): Emilio checks the learner in for flight 223 to Mexico City: destination, passport, bags, a safety question (twist: a power bank in the suitcase), the scale (twist: two kilos over: pay or move things), window or aisle (twist: no window seats), the boarding pass.

items.prompt: Emilio, the check-in agent, stands behind the counter about one third from the left, one hand resting on the counter and the other waving the learner forward, with a professional smile ("¡Buenos días! Pase, por favor.").
Change only his pose and expression: he holds out one open hand, palm up, across the counter for the learner's passport, with a professional smile.
Change only his pose and expression: he leans a little over the counter and gestures with an open hand toward the empty baggage scale beside it, eyebrows raised (any bags to check?).
items.note: 5 Nov audit: remade (nearly the same as greet, with no scale to point at) as an edit of overweight (Batch API); the audit manifest in the work folder's audit/ holds the prompt.

items.prompt: Change only his pose and expression: he holds up a small plain gray power bank with a short cable (no text) between two fingers, eyebrows raised, with a serious but friendly look (anything like this in your suitcase?).

Change only his pose and expression: he shakes his head gently and points at a small dark backpack (the learner's carry-on) resting on the edge of the counter, apologetic but firm (the power bank goes in here, not in the suitcase).
Change only his pose and expression: a teal hard-shell suitcase now stands on the baggage scale beside the counter, the scale's display blank; he glances at it with one hand on the keyboard.
items.note: 5 Nov audit: remade (the suitcase stood behind the agent, and there was no scale) as an edit of overweight (Batch API); the audit manifest in the work folder's audit/ holds the prompt.

items.prompt: Change only his pose and expression: the teal suitcase stands on the baggage scale; he holds up two fingers with an apologetic grimace, glancing at the scale's blank display (two kilos over).

Change only his pose and expression: the teal suitcase lies open on the floor beside the scale, a folded sweater and a pair of sneakers lifted out next to it; he waits patiently, hands folded on the counter, with a small encouraging smile.
Change only his pose and expression: he turns a card terminal with a blank screen toward the learner on the counter, with a polite smile (the overweight fee).

Change only his pose and expression: he holds up a laminated seat map of the plane, rows of small blank squares with an aisle down the middle (no numbers), a fingertip on a window seat, eyebrows raised (window or aisle?).
Change only his pose and expression: he lowers the seat map with an apologetic look, one palm turned up (the window seats are all taken).

Change only his pose and expression: he hands a boarding pass across the counter (a blank paper card with only a small plane icon and gray lines), the learner's passport tucked under it, with a professional smile.
